workflow:
  name: karta-ref-retry
  resources:
    default:
      cpu: 1
      memory: 512Mi
      storage: 1Gi
      platform: reference-cpu
  tasks:
  - name: retry-worker
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu@sha256:68ee22004a9109b44973313b02ff7b1de250f1de0f5ecb628d73f579aaff33ac
    command: [/bin/sh, -c]
    args:
    - >-
      echo reference-retry-${OSMO_REFERENCE_RETRY:?retry label missing};
      sleep 45;
      if [ "$OSMO_REFERENCE_RETRY" = 0 ]; then exit 75; fi;
      echo reference-retry-done
    exitActions:
      RESCHEDULE: "75"
